Variants.Content: The Drowned God is central to the Ironborn's ideas of life at sea, death, and rebirth. The islanders believe that the gods who come from the sea will not be defeated by wind and waves. Greenland people often cannot understand this kind of awe; for fishermen and plunderers, the sea is both a gift from God and the most just judge.
